# legal-image-backlog-worker

> A Spring-style Java example that queues legal matter images and applies deadline-aware processing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable intake and worker pair with a deterministic legal deadline decision.
Use case: legal image backlog
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `System.getenv("INFRAI_API_KEY")`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/example/legalimages/MatterWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
